Liquid Glass revision in iOS 27 and macOS 27

Apple’s 2026 revision of Liquid Glass: a user slider from ultra-clear to fully tinted, sharper icons, and on the Mac a return to edge-to-edge sidebars and a uniform toolbar.

Source
Apple Newsroom, June 8, 2026
Creator
Apple
Made
2026 (announced at WWDC in June 2026; released September 2026)
Style
Liquid Glass (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Calm, focused, luminous
Evidence
Inspected the Apple Newsroom image Apple-OS-27-updates-260608 (1960 × 1102, large_2x variant) in a scratchpad copy. The screens are small, so glass detail is not visible at this size, and the description relies mostly on Apple’s text. Not stored.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple: “A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultra-clear to fully tinted”, and “app icons have been updated to be sharper and more defined. On Mac, updates reincorporate cornerstones of the macOS design … including a more uniform toolbar across the top of apps, edge-to-edge sidebars, colored sidebar icons, and more.” Apple Newsroom, June 2026.

Apple’s developer release: “the design continues to evolve, with improvements to legibility, customizability, and consistency”. Apple Newsroom. The software shipped in September 2026. Apple Newsroom.

Wikipedia reports that the revision addressed criticism, reduced default transparency, and changed sidebar corners on iPadOS and macOS. Wikipedia: Liquid Glass.

Observed

  • A product group on white: Vision Pro, a MacBook, an iPad, an iPhone, and an Apple Watch.
  • On the Mac, the Image Playground window is dark. Its sidebar runs to the window edge instead of floating as an inset panel, and the toolbar buttons are small separate capsules.
  • On the iPad, an “Allowed Apps” sheet is an opaque white rounded panel over a beige wave wallpaper, with a blue check button in a circle.
  • The Mac Dock is a dark strip with a faint rim.

Why it belongs

The revision moves the style back toward opaque, structured surfaces. The capsule controls and concentric corners remain, so these are what define the style after 2026, more than strong transparency.

Borrow

Offer a user setting from clear to tinted glass instead of one fixed transparency.

See also the 2025 and 2026 icon edge and macOS Tahoe 26 Control Center.
